# Gameplay

`cinnabar:extension/gameplay@0.1.0`

Explicit local gameplay capabilities; no raw packet access.

**Grants:** Per operation: `players`, `terrain`, `movement`, `camera`, `interaction`, `entities`, `commands` or `packet_delay`; see each function.

## Types

<a id="type-vector3"></a>

### `vector3`

Three coordinates; the containing record or function specifies their units and frame.

```wit
record vector3 {
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
    z: f32,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `f32` |  |
| `y` | `f32` |  |
| `z` | `f32` |  |

<a id="type-player"></a>

### `player`

Types: [`vector3`](gameplay.md#type-vector3).

<a id="type-snapshot"></a>

### `snapshot`

Current input-owned frame only. Angles are actor YXZ radians: yaw left, pitch up.

```wit
record snapshot {
    session: u64,
    dimension: s32,
    eye: vector3,
    yaw: f32,
    pitch: f32,
    frame-seconds: f32,
    players: list<player>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session` | `u64` |  |
| `dimension` | `s32` |  |
| `eye` | `vector3` |  |
| `yaw` | `f32` |  |
| `pitch` | `f32` |  |
| `frame-seconds` | `f32` |  |
| `players` | `list<player>` |  |

Types: [`player`](gameplay.md#type-player), [`vector3`](gameplay.md#type-vector3).

<a id="type-movement-snapshot"></a>

### `movement-snapshot`

```wit
    session: u64,

    on-ground: bool,
```

<a id="type-movement-intents"></a>

### `movement-intents`

True holds the control as if its binding were held; false adds nothing to physical input.

```wit

    sprint: bool,
    sneak: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sprint` | `bool` |  |
| `sneak` | `bool` |  |

<a id="type-control-modes"></a>

### `control-modes`

The game's own control modes, replacing the player's toggle sprint, toggle sneak and
always sprint settings while renewed. Always sprint applies only to keyboard and mouse.

```wit
record control-modes {
    toggle-sprint: bool,
    toggle-sneak: bool,
    always-sprint: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle-sprint` | `bool` |  |
| `toggle-sneak` | `bool` |  |
| `always-sprint` | `bool` |  |

<a id="type-mob"></a>

```wit
    type-id: string,

    health: option<f32>,
```

## Functions

<a id="read-frame"></a>

### `read-frame`

```wit
read-frame: func() -> result<option<snapshot>, string>;
```

Requires players or terrain; player rows require players. None means gameplay does not own input.

Types: [`snapshot`](gameplay.md#type-snapshot).

<a id="read-movement"></a>

### `read-movement`

```wit
read-movement: func() -> result<option<movement-snapshot>, string>;
```

Requires movement authority; none means gameplay does not own input.

Types: [`movement-snapshot`](gameplay.md#type-movement-snapshot).

<a id="pulse-jump"></a>

### `pulse-jump`

```wit
pulse-jump: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

Stages one ordinary jump input for the next physics tick, with movement authority.

<a id="cancel-jump"></a>

### `cancel-jump`

```wit
cancel-jump: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

Cancels pending local jump input after a successful callback, even outside gameplay.

<a id="set-movement-intents"></a>

### `set-movement-intents`

```wit
set-movement-intents: func(intents: option<movement-intents>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Renew every focused gameplay frame; omission releases both intents. Requires movement
authority; server movement, hunger and item-use restrictions still apply.

Types: [`movement-intents`](gameplay.md#type-movement-intents).

<a id="set-control-modes"></a>

### `set-control-modes`

```wit
set-control-modes: func(modes: option<control-modes>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Renew every focused gameplay frame; omission restores the player's own settings.
Requires movement authority. With several mods, a mode is on when any of them sets it.

Types: [`control-modes`](gameplay.md#type-control-modes).

<a id="rotate"></a>

### `rotate`

```wit
rotate: func(yaw-delta: f32, pitch-delta: f32) -> result<_, string>;
```

Requires the camera grant and a current frame; commits only after frame returns.

<a id="set-attack-reach"></a>

### `set-attack-reach`

```wit
set-attack-reach: func(blocks: option<f32>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Requires interaction authority; a non-none range also requires a current gameplay frame.
Overrides local actor pick and attack range up to MAX_ENTITY_REACH_BLOCKS; none restores
ordinary mode and input limits. Attack eligibility, obstruction and server validation
still apply. Does not change mining or block-use reach.

<a id="pulse-attack"></a>

### `pulse-attack`

```wit
pulse-attack: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

One attack-press edge, only while the physical attack control is held.
An active action filter receives it as a repeat.

<a id="set-packet-delay"></a>

### `set-packet-delay`

```wit
set-packet-delay: func(delay-ms: u32) -> result<_, string>;
```

Requires packet-delay authority; 0 drains the queue, maximum 1000 milliseconds.
Delays post-login application packets in both directions, without raw packet access.
Retained only after a successful callback; no current gameplay frame required.

<a id="read-relayed-position"></a>

### `read-relayed-position`

```wit
read-relayed-position: func() -> result<option<vector3>, string>;
```

Requires packet-delay authority: the local feet position last relayed to the server, which
trails the presented position while packets are delayed. None outside gameplay or while no
delay is active.

Types: [`vector3`](gameplay.md#type-vector3).

<a id="read-camera"></a>

### `read-camera`

```wit
read-camera: func() -> result<option<camera-pose>, string>;
```

Requires players or terrain, as read-frame. None means gameplay does not own input.

Types: [`camera-pose`](gameplay.md#type-camera-pose).

<a id="set-camera-rig"></a>


Retained third-person rig, swept against blocks; none restores the player's own view.

Types: [`camera-rig`](gameplay.md#type-camera-rig).

<a id="request-command"></a>

### `request-command`

```wit

```

Sent as a player command request after frame returns; the command must be granted by name.
